en: Saint-Tropez is a village of 4,000 residents that receives **80,000 visitors a day in summer**. The road leading there is a single lane for several kilometres, and weekend traffic jams can last two hours. Amani Limousines provides a private chauffeur in Saint-Tropez who knows the right times to travel, the shortcuts through Grimaud and the back routes along the beach road. We drive you there from Nice, from La Môle airfield or from your yacht. You travel in a Mercedes, and the fare is fixed before you set off.

Once you are there, your chauffeur can stay with you for the whole day. Pampelonne beach, with **4.5 km of sand just 5 km from the village**, is a good example: drop-off at Club 55 or La Réserve à la Plage, shuttles back to the village whenever you want, and a pickup at sunset. On the peninsula, Château Minuty, Château des Marres and Domaines Ott pour their Côtes de Provence rosés. You taste, he drives. In the evening, the hill villages of Gassin and Ramatuelle look out over the Golden Isles. Port-Grimaud is 7 km away. After a night at Les Caves du Roy, you are taken back to your villa at any hour.
